  "payments".id AS "payments_id",
  "merchant".label AS "merchant_label"
FROM "explorer"."sim_payments"."payments" AS "payments"
LEFT OUTER JOIN "explorer"."sim_merchants"."merchant" AS "merchant"
  ON ("payments".merchant_id) = ("merchant".id)
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY "payments_id"
LIMIT 10
